statusLine.command: input=$(cat); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd'); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); branch=$(git -C "$dir" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo ''); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); [ -n "$branch" ] && git_info=" ($branch)" || git_info=''; [ -n "$used" ] && ctx_info=" | ${used}% used" || ctx_info=''; printf "\033[2m%s%s | %s%s\033[0m" "$(basename "$dir")" "$git_info" "$model" "$ctx_info"
